hypotheses.statement: Scale hierarchy makes the dark coupe the unmistakable hero while the smaller yellow car acts as a contrasting foil that pulls the eye left then returns to the hero.
Large flat gray sky and pavement envelope the scene in a muted, calm mood that makes the small warm yellows and ambers feel more vivid and nostalgic.
Low front three-quarter viewpoint with overlapping depth layers creates an informal gathering rhythm moving diagonally from background sculpture through cars to right-edge crowd.

relations.rule: Keep photography dominant and confine any legible text to a tiny functional label under 3% of frame height near the bottom edge.
Restrict palette to desaturated grays plus exactly one saturated warm hue for a secondary element.
Preserve 40-50% open muted background above the subject to isolate the silhouette.

fragile_if_changed: Replace the flat overcast gray sky with bright blue or make the yellow car equal in size to the dark coupe and the muted single-hero car-meet mood would collapse.
